name: @distlab/kernel
description: Deterministic canonical-data and execution-history primitives for DistLab.

scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @distlab/contracts --silent && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.golden:01: npm run build -w @distlab/contracts --silent && npm run build -w @distlab/kernel --silent && node --experimental-strip-types examples/golden-01.ts
scripts.test: npm run build -w @distlab/contracts --silent && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && node --test --experimental-strip-types tests/*.test.ts
